sources.description: Temperatures in US state forecast to hit high 30s celsius this week, while regions in Indonesia grapple with wildfires The National Weather Service in the US has issued extreme heat warnings for parts of southern California, including Los Angeles, until Thursday, as temperatures are expected to hit the high 30s celsius. Burbank, a suburb north of Los Angeles, recorded 39C on Saturday, a few degrees shy of the October record for the region set in 1987. A persistent area of high pressure will remain in place this week, leading to further hazardous hot weather and increased fire risk. Parts of Indonesia are in the midst of an extreme wildfire season, which has peaked over the past month. Western Kalimantan (Borneo) and southern Sumatra have been particularly badly affected. The lack of rainfall has dried the usually water-logged tropical soils, meaning that fires have been able to spread quickly, above and below the surface. Indonesia’s soils are also extremely rich in peat, meaning that the smoke produced from the fires contain higher levels of toxic gases such as sulphur dioxide and carbon monoxide. Cities in surrounding areas and as far as Malaysia and Singapore have experienced reduced air quality in recent weeks as a result. sources.description: 中新网10月6日电 据“中国铁路”微信公众号消息，10月5日，全国铁路发送旅客2104.7万人次，运输安全平稳有序。10月6日，全国铁路迎来返程客流高峰，预计发送旅客2210万人次，计划加开旅客列车2199列。

sources.title: 沙特主导联军空袭胡塞武装遭反击
sources.description: 中新社北京10月6日电 综合消息：当地时间5日，也门政府宣布启动“也门黎明”行动，沙特阿拉伯主导的多国联军当天出动战机空袭胡塞武装目标，也门政府军向红海沿岸推进。作为回应，胡塞武装同日袭击沙特境内多个目标，并警告国际航空公司停止飞越沙特领空。

sources.title: 铜价连续刷新历史高点 铜产业需跳出结构性困局
sources.description: 近期，铜价连续刷新历史高点。伦敦金属交易所3个月期铜价格盘中一度突破14800美元/吨，创历史新高；国内沪铜主力合约也站上11万元/吨关口。随后价格虽迅速回撤，但整体仍运行在高位区间。
